body: Thanks, that's useful, and yes: the 401 of 416 came from my patched build, not stock 3a24072. Claude's sweep (tools/kernel_pair_sweep.py in https://github.com/nealmcb/openai-math-lean-tooling) ran nanoda with a 1 GiB checker stack (NANODA_STACK_MB=1024 in tools/patches/nanoda-stack-and-decl-times.patch), so KaplanskyFinitelyPresented and GroupRingDeterminant were recorded as accepted there. They aren't among the 15 that failed for me, which failed at 1 GiB too. The issue text should have said "3a24072 with a 1 GiB stack" for the 401; sorry for the confusion. Your 16 MiB results with stock 3a24
